en-US.description: A font management platform for discovering, licensing, organizing, and activating fonts.
en-US.longDescription: Monotype Connect (formerly Extensis Connect) is a font management platform that brings font discovery, licensing, and management into a single connected experience. The Connect desktop application replaces Suitcase Fusion and adds web-based font activation, so fonts can be activated on any device without installing the font files. It supports full font families from Adobe, Monotype, and partner foundries, and integrates with desktop and web applications.
en-US.name: Monotype Connect
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release introduces new features, expanded integrations, and performance improvements.
- Library Deletion Recovery: Deleted libraries can now be recovered within 30 days before permanent removal. Administrator access is required to restore libraries. [learn more]
- Adobe Creative Cloud 2027 Support: Updated font activation plugins provide compatibility with the latest Adobe Creative Cloud applications.
  - Important: Adobe Creative Cloud 2024 is no longer supported.
- New Font Panels for Adobe Creative Cloud 2027: Introducing an enhanced font panel experience for Adobe Creative Cloud applications InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop. [learn more]
- Google Workspace SSO: Added Google Workspace Single Sign-On (SSO) support for streamlined authentication and user management. [learn more]
- Performance and Stability: Additional enhancements, performance optimizations, and bug fixes to improve the overall experience.

zh-CN.description: 一个用于发现、授权、整理和激活字体的字体管理平台。
zh-CN.longDescription: Monotype Connect（原名 Extensis Connect）是一个字体管理平台，将字体发现、授权和管理整合为统一的互联体验。Connect 桌面应用程序取代了 Suitcase Fusion，并增加了基于 Web 的字体激活功能，因此无需安装字体文件即可在任何设备上激活字体。它支持来自 Adobe、Monotype 及其合作伙伴字库的完整字体家族，并可与桌面及 Web 应用程序集成。
